notes: Good early R&D pressure (Fujii T1, Hybrid Release T2, Yagi-Uda T3), but extra R&D runs on T2/T3 just re-saw the same top card. On T8, T9, T14 and T15 it kept running Server 3, passing Anemone, then jacking out before access, which cost about 6 clicks and 7 cards to net damage and never checked the advanced card. It won through Transfer of Wealth + Docklands Pass on T15.

On T1 it spent everything on three ice plus the Hagen rez and lost Architect Deployment Test from an HQ with unrezzed ice, then was stuck near 0 credits until T8 (installed Otto T2 with no money, added a third HQ ice T5 instead of saving up for Hedge Fund). Later scoring with Ansel/Ablative in Server 2 was solid, but Superconducting Hub went into the one-unrezzed-ice Server 1 on T15 and was stolen; won with Méliès on T19.

After a Raindrops run on T2 it clicked for credits every turn from T3 to T18 and reached 74 credits without installing a breaker or playing a card. Only one other run all game (T5 into Tree Line, plus the T10 Luana trash), while the Corp scored Above the Law, Transport Monopoly, Divested Trust x2 and Above the Law from Server 2 uncontested. No coherent plan.

The log stops on runner turn 2 with no winner, so there is very little to judge. T1 ice on HQ/R&D plus Hedge Fund and T2 extra ice were standard, and the Ansel rez trashed Daily Casts; nothing wrong in what is shown.

Strong HQ pressure with Shibboleth + Docklands Pass (Transfer of Wealth steal T2, double steal T10) and a clean Revolver break through Server 2 for Regenesis, then Archives for the win on T12. Odd spots: Lie Low overdraw that forced a discard of 2 on T2, and on T3 it facechecked Jinteki's Server 2 into Anemone, lost 3 cards, then jacked out after passing the only ice.

It never rezzed the R&D ice even at 11-15 credits, so the Runner walked in on T2, T4, T5 and T6 and stole Project Ingatan twice. It built a three-ice Server 1 but never installed anything in it, and spent T4-T8 clicking for credits and Petty Cash while holding Méliès and Architect Deployment Test in an HQ guarded only by Ansel; both were taken on T7-T8.

Good use of Banner to get through Akhet (Divested Trust T3) and to steal SDS Drone Deployment through four ice on T6, then Buzzsaw on R&D and Boi-tatá to finish via Server 2 on T13. Minor issues: it went to 0 credits on T1 and T3 (the T3 R&D run into unrezzed Afshar with 2 credits was a facecheck), and T5 ended with a hand-size discard.

Extra R&D runs on T1 and T3 re-accessed the same unchanged top card. From T4 to T14 it clicked for credits every turn up to 55 credits, never playing a card from its 5-card grip and never contesting Server 1, where Above the Law was scored twice. The only remote run came on T15 and the Corp won on T16.

It left R&D unprotected T1-T3, so Next Big Thing was stolen, then on T4 spent to 0 credits on Oppo Research (with the extra payment) and had nothing to follow up the tags with. From T5 to T9 it spent 2 credits and a click every turn trashing Stoneship Chart Room while broke, discarded at end of turn on T7-T9, never rezzed the R&D ice, never built a remote, and lost the second NBT and Embedded Reporting from R&D.

Solid NBN play: it scored Next Big Thing (T4), Post-Truth Dividend (T8) and two Embedded Reportings from the Ping-guarded Server 2, with Spin Doctor and Predictive Planogram for money. The one slip was putting an Embedded Reporting into the new one-ice Server 3 on T10 against a Runner holding 39 credits, and it was stolen; NBT T5 emptied HQ oddly.

Fast-advancing two Tomorrow's Headlines (T2, T5) and the later scores were good, and the Oppo Research tags locked the Runner's clicks. But HQ had no ice until T10 despite 10-18 credits (T6 was three credit clicks), and the Runner ran it every turn and stole Next Big Thing (T8) and Embedded Reporting (T9).

Sensible Buzzsaw R&D digging stole Above the Law (T4) and SDS + Transport Monopoly (T8), but it never found an answer to Akhet/Ballista, so the Corp scored from Server 1 freely. Leech counters went unused, Privileged Access cost credits that left it exposed to Measured Response on T12, and on T13 it ran Server 1 with a new Banner into Ballista and lost it.

Post-Truth Dividend (T2) and Next Big Thing (T6) both went into Server 1 behind a lone 1-cost Paywall and were stolen. From T8 to T11 it clicked for credits every turn at 10-19 credits and discarded at end of turn instead of icing up; it added Server 1 ice only on T12, then scored NBT and two Embedded Reportings to win on T18.

Good start (Transfer of Wealth stole Longevity Serum T1; Red Team/Jailbreak T5), but runs 2-4 on T2 re-accessed the same R&D card. Once Revolver ran out of counters it kept Red Team-running into Karunā on T6 and T7 (four times, 2 net damage each) instead of hitting the one-ice Server 3 holding Regenesis. It flatlined itself on T7 by running HQ with one card in grip.

Well-rounded game: Shibboleth/Revolver/Tremolo covered the ice, it checked the Jinteki remotes early (Mavirus, Urtica Cipher), and later steered clear of the known Urtica in Server 3. Steals came from HQ (Longevity Serum T6, Yagi-Uda T9) and Fujii from Archives (T7); the only flaw was spending to 0 credits on T2.

It did not rez HQ ice on T1 (Megaprix stolen), then repeatedly installed and rezzed Nico Campaign in unprotected remotes (T2, T6, T7, T8), and the Runner trashed each one. It advanced Méliès in Server 1 on T5 with 0 credits left to rez the ice, so Overclock stole it, and it never rezzed R&D defence beyond Drafter, losing two Ingatans from R&D.

It found Buzzsaw on T1 and hammered the Descent-guarded HQ, taking Transport Monopoly (T2, T6), Divested Trust (T6) and Above the Law (T7) for a quick win, and also trashed Luana. The only inefficiency was some credit clicks at 9+ credits on T3 and T5 where more HQ runs were available.

It never rezzed the R&D ice despite 10-27 credits, so the Runner ran R&D almost every turn and stole ADT (T3) and Megaprix (T5). It stacked four ice on Server 2 and never installed anything in it, and from T8 to T13 it only clicked for credits (discarding at end of turn) while holding Méliès and Ingatan in HQ, both later stolen.

Strong scoring plan: Ingatan from a T1 remote, a multi-click T10 (Wage Workers, Otto) scoring Superconducting Hub, Méliès via Seamless Launch T12 and ADT T16 behind Ansel/Vertigo/Bloop. Weak spots were R&D with no ice T1-T2 (Ingatan stolen T3) and Megaprix put into the single-unrezzed-ice Server 2 on T7, where it was stolen.

On T1-T2 it ran the unprotected HQ eight times (seeing Luana, Descent and Hedge Fund repeatedly) and ignored the one-ice Server 1 holding Above the Law. It then clicked for credits nearly every turn from T3 to T13, reaching 37 credits without installing a single card, and only bounced off ice on T6, T8, T10 and T13 while the Corp scored five agendas.
